name: Apoorva Sharma
summary:

organizational effectiveness across EPC, infrastructure, and energy sectors.

compliance, budgeting, policy formulation, and HR digitization.

informed decision-making and process improvement.
▶ Proven change enabler, delivering structured onboarding and leadership communication
platforms to enhance employee experience and alignment.
